🔥 Calgary Urban Heat: How the Solid-to-Tree Ratio drives an 8°C gap

My Summer 2025 ML satellite analysis reveals a direct relationship between a community's built-to-canopy footprint and surface temperature (LST):

🌳 Cooling Refuges (~29.5–31°C): Roxboro, Rideau Park, Discovery Ridge, Eau Claire (mature canopies + river valleys).
🔥 Northeast Heat Dome (~37–38°C): Marlborough, Rundle, Temple (dense low-rise footprint, minimal mature canopy).
🏗️ New Suburbs: Seton, Redstone, Rangeview (canopy lag: fully built out, but young saplings need years to mature).

🌲 Urban trees are not decorative landscaping — they are critical municipal climate infrastructure.
